analyticsRules.description: Detects critical security alerts from Falco indicating potential security breaches
analyticsRules.query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where priority_s == "Critical"
| project TimeGenerated, output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, rule_s, output_s, hostname_s

analyticsRules.description: Detects suspicious process execution patterns in Kubernetes containers
analyticsRules.query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where rule_s contains "Unauthorized Process" or rule_s contains "Package Management"
| summarize Count = count() by output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, output_fields_container_name_s, rule_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Count > 5

analyticsRules.description: Detects unauthorized access to sensitive files in containers
analyticsRules.query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where rule_s contains "Sensitive File Access" or rule_s contains "Kubernetes Secret Access"
| project TimeGenerated, output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, output_fields_user_name_s, rule_s, output_s

analyticsRules.description: Detects potential reverse shell connections from containers
analyticsRules.query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where rule_s contains "Reverse Shell"
| project TimeGenerated, output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, output_s, hostname_s, output_fields_container_id_s

analyticsRules.displayName: Falco - Multiple Security Alerts from Same Pod
analyticsRules.description: Detects multiple security alerts originating from the same pod indicating potential compromise
analyticsRules.query:
FalcoLogs_CL
| where priority_s in ("Critical", "Error", "Warning")
| summarize AlertCount = count(), Rules = make_set(rule_s) by output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where AlertCount >= 5
| project TimeGenerated, output_fields_k8s_pod_name_s, output_fields_k8s_ns_name_s, AlertCount, Rules
